more_info.overview: Nicotinic acid, also called niacin, is the nutrient compound chemically named 3-pyridinecarboxylic acid. Food-grade material is a stable white crystalline solid that dissolves in water and alcohol. FDA identifies its direct-food function as nutrient supplementation. This older E-number entry refers to nicotinic acid, so it should be distinguished from other niacin-related ingredients.
more_info.uses: Used for nutrient fortification under current US good-manufacturing-practice conditions.
